column26: Quick reload is 0.80s long. It triggers when you have emptied a magazine, and when you have a "quick magazine" available (indicated by the bars near your ammo count). Otherwise, a normal reload will occur.  Quick-magazine variant in source: 60 (30).  Quick-reload variant in source: 2.80 (0.80)s.
Takes ~160ms to fire the 1st shot. Various methods of optimizing TTK: https://i.imgur.com/DLfa7hv.jpeg (qm = quick melee). TTK does not account for projectile travel time.

Takes ~640ms to charge a shot. Various methods of optimizing TTK: https://i.imgur.com/DLfa7hv.jpeg (qm = quick melee). TTK does not account for projectile travel time.  Damage increases from 60 to 124 (continuously) based on how long this weapon was charged.
Bullets are hitscan up until 40m, and then converted into projectiles afterwards.
TTK does not account for projectile travel time, or the initial delay when throwing the knives.  It represents more of a "time-to-death" calculation, if anything.

Firing the weapon will cancel the reload animation.

Deals 104 damage on hit (8 x 13 pellets), and then an extra ~31 damage from the fire DoT that last for ~2 seconds.  DoT does not stack, and it resets on every hit.  With the DoT, it takes 2 hits to kill a Light (or 1 hit + quick-melee), 2 hits to kill a Medium, and 3 hits to kill a Heavy.  Can quick-melee to optimize TTK after hitting last shot.
Despite firing crossbow bolts, this is a hitscan weapon.
Firing the weapon will cancel the reload animation.
Noticeable spread when maximizing its fire rate, so optimal TTK is not achievable outside of close range.  Slow down your shot pacing at further distances.
(need information about whether or not the fire DoT sticks to the player while dealing damage with Flamethrower ammo)
Shots are hitscan within 25m, and then they become projectiles afterwards (with a projectile velocity of 280 m/s).  Firing the weapon will cancel the reload animation.

TTK assumes a full ramp-up to maximum fire rate.  Major levels of spread make it 100% accurate only at extreme close range (within ~5m).  Spin-up time until minimum fire rate (500 RPM) is 0.90s.  Spin-up time until maximum fire rate (1500 RPM) is 1.60s.
Rounds detonate on impact after the 1st bounce. Maximum fuse time = 2.5s. Explosion inner radius = 2m.

Quick reload is 0.80s long. It triggers when you have emptied a magazine, and when you have a "quick magazine" available (indicated by the bars near your ammo count). Otherwise, a normal reload will occur.  Quick-magazine variant in source: 16 (4).  Quick-reload variant in source: 3.25 (0.80)s.
Shoots 2 rounds per shot, spread out horizontally, each dealing 15 damage.
